title: Class template: Stack<T>
prompt: Implement `template <typename T> class Stack` backed by `std::vector<T>` with: `void push(T)`, `T pop()` (removes and returns the top — moving, not copying), `const T& top() const`, `bool empty() const`, `std::size_t size() const`. It must instantiate for int and std::string.

tests.name: lifo-int
strings
move-out
tests.hint: pop() hands the value out and leaves the stack empty.

tests.name: move-only
tests.hint: unique_ptr is non-copyable: only a moving pop() compiles.
